messages:
Dmitri: quick heads-up — I'm landing a Terraform module refactor for payments-api. Splitting payments/core -> payments/processor, hoisting provider refs to the repo root, and renaming the Vault secret path from `secret/data/payments` -> `secret/data/services/payments`. I'll regen the lockfile. Any immediate red flags?

Alice: can you paste the plan diff? main worries: state move and k8s SA bindings.

Dmitri: plan excerpt below (short):
```
- module.payments_core.aws_iam_role.sa -> module.payments_processor.aws_iam_role.sa (resource moved)
+ module.payments_processor.null_resource.post_migrate_script (new)
```
I'll run `terraform state mv module.payments_core.aws_iam_role.sa module.payments_processor.aws_iam_role.sa` as part of the migration script.

Ben: ok. couple of notes: 1) ensure `required_providers` in child modules don't pin to a different registry host after hoist. keep root/providers.tf with the mirror config. 2) lockfile regen: run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64,linux_arm64` and commit `.terraform.lock.hcl`.

Carla: also double-check any module calls that reference `module.payments_core.*` outputs — they need to be updated or aliased. Can you add a temporary compatibility alias?

Dmitri: good call — I'll add a shim module `payments_core_compat` that forwards outputs to the new module for a short window. migration script will include:
```
# move state
terraform state mv module.payments_core.aws_iam_role.sa module.payments_processor.aws_iam_role.sa
# apply shim
terraform apply -target=module.payments_core_compat
```

Alice: vault path rename will affect k8s secrets mounted by the payments deploy. We'll need to update helm values. Example change in values.yaml: `vault.path: "secret/data/services/payments"`

Ben: verify that the KMS / K/V versions are compatible with the new path. If you're moving keys, talk to security. Also check CI: our terraform plan job uses `TF_DATA_DIR` and caching — make sure lockfile appears in the job workspace.

infra-bot: CI job queued: terraform/plan (payments-refactor) — will run terraform 1.5.x with providers from lockfile.

Dmitri: thanks — I'll update the PR with a migration checklist and a smoke test: `ci/terraform-smoke --module payments_processor`. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987 

Carla: I'll take the first review pass. Quick ask: will you include a one-time job to rotate the k8s secret if the path change is required?

Dmitri: yes, adding a k8s job script to run: `kubectl -n payments rollout restart deployment/payments` and a job that runs a small Pod to copy secrets if needed. snippet: 
```sh
kubectl -n payments create job migrate-vault-path --image=bitnami/kubectl -- /bin/sh -c "./copy-secret.sh"
```

Alice: ping me when the shim is in place so I can update Helm values and run a canary. :thumbsup:

Ben: FYI if anyone hits provider mismatch errors after hoist, run: `terraform init -upgrade -reconfigure` and check `.terraform.lock.hcl` diffs.

Dmitri: will do. planning to merge after CI smoke and one canary in staging. tagging infra-oncall for any late-night fallout. :wave:

Carla: noted. lgtm for staging rollout after your migration script lands.

Dmitri: thanks everyone — will post final status in this thread when done.
